blurb: Guests can take English Hunt Seat riding lessons for all levels ages 6 years to adults, learn total horse care, and participate in group classes arranged in 7 or 8 week sessions. Camps are available for younger children to experience riding lessons, horse care, and games. The farm also offers birthday parties with horseback riding and picnic facilities, hayrides, and facility rentals for events.
extraNote: One make-up lesson per session with 24hr notice, must be made up in current session · Session fees not reduced for missed lessons · Tuition due at beginning of session, may be paid in two payments
